messages:
hana: Notifying the group: some Dedicated console builds started failing after telemetry bumped to v3. Build time duplicate types (TelemetryEvent / TelemetryClient).
peter: Can you paste the minimal bundle error?
hana: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/3056789-repro. It's a tsc/webpack duplicate identifier error during console build.
arun: Short term: vendor the telemetry package into the console canary to unblock customers. Medium term: publish small compat shims for TS and Py that normalize v2/v3.
kai: For JS, recommend shim + mark concrete telemetry as a peerDependency. SDKs depend on shim; console provides concrete implementation. Avoids long-term pinning.
hana: Py mirror: publish redwood_telemetry_shim that lazy-imports telemetry_v2 or telemetry_v3 and falls back to no-op client if missing. Keeps pip installs safe.
arun: Add CI bundling test that builds console with both telemetry versions present to catch duplicates.
peter: I'll scaffold TS shim PR and a short README for integrators. Hana will coordinate support comms and canary vendoring.
hana: Action items: peter -> TS shim, arun -> Py shim + CI test, kai -> docs snippet for peerDependency pattern. devex-bot: reminder set for 3 days to review canary.
